# freepage.app

> Free, browser-based document writer. No login, no cloud, no downloads.

## Key Facts

- 100% free, no account required
- Rich text editor with formatting toolbar and keyboard shortcuts
- All documents saved to browser localStorage
- Export to .txt, .md, .html, .pdf, and .docx
- Import .txt and .md files
- Real-time word count, character count, reading time
- Multiple document management with sidebar
- Auto-save every 2 seconds
- Focus mode for distraction-free writing
- Find and replace
- Dark mode support
- Works offline after first visit
- Mobile responsive
